lineage.strategy: Shift from European manufacturing/launch plans to realized current-quarter revenue, profitability, liquidity and forward guidance.

observations.fact: Planet reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $116.1 million, up 58% year over year, with adjusted EBITDA profit of $13.9 million and cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of $865.4 million.
Planet guided full-year FY2027 revenue to approximately $430-$441 million, adjusted EBITDA profit of $3-$10 million and capital expenditures of $100-$115 million.
For Q3 FY2027 Planet expects $101-$105 million of revenue and an adjusted EBITDA loss of approximately $6-$1 million, indicating a sequential step-down after the record Q2.

risks.risk: The Q3 outlook implies sequential revenue contraction and a return to adjusted EBITDA loss despite strong Q2 growth; current performance should not be extrapolated linearly.

unknowns.unknown: This release-level evidence does not isolate margin or cash returns from the Berlin manufacturing expansion and Isar launch path; project-level economics remain unknown.

recommendation: Use current realized revenue/profitability/liquidity plus explicit forward guidance as underwriting evidence; preserve the Q3 sequential slowdown as a risk rather than extrapolating Q2.
